title: 小六课文参照回填：一张周末路线图
instruction: 先阅读本套自有课文配套，再依据配套原句完成全部十题。每空一词，首字母已给；输入完整单词（含首字母）。配套随题可见，可自愿合上后练习，但本页不把它称为受控的延时记忆测验。未列出的表达暂标待复核。
source_notice: 主参照原教辅“根据课文内容、首字母已给、每空一词”的完整十句结构，原1/3/10文字及2/5/6/8页图共对应7/10；4/7/9课文对应、具体版次和正式键仍缺。这里另外编齐本套自有课文配套，不是补写原课文，也不以作者全输入升级源完整或gold。四段配套是作者编排选择，不据此称原卷只有四段；页面允许直接参照，未复现此前课堂教学、背诵或延时条件，不能当记忆能力/年级效度已验证。独立教研、学生、商用和生产未验证。

lessons.title: A. At the bookshop
lessons.text: Nina and her father visited a new bookshop on Friday. The maps were behind the counter. A shop assistant showed them a small town map. Follow the red line to the art shop. This was the first instruction printed on it. Nina bought a pencil at the bookshop before they went home.

lessons.title: B. The Saturday plan
lessons.text: The next morning, Nina invited her cousin to join her. There were twelve pictures on the town map. They decided to visit three of the places. We must arrive before the doors close at four. Nina wrote that reminder on a small card. The card fit inside her coat pocket.

lessons.title: C. A change of plan
lessons.text: Their first stop was the old museum beside the lake. They wanted to see a model ship. We stayed inside because the rain was heavy. From a window, they watched people opening umbrellas. When the rain stopped, they continued their walk to the art shop.

lessons.title: D. Checking the route
lessons.text: The walk from the lake took a quarter of an hour. The cousins stopped once to check the map. The art shop was on the east side of the square. They found it beside a bakery. Nina chose a postcard with a picture of the model ship on it.
